title: Add admin permission levels and skill proficiency management to existing admin panel

requirements.text: Add admin permission levels to the backend by creating an admin registry that stores Principal IDs of users with admin access. Include methods to add, remove, and check admin status.

quotes: Admin permission levels for access control

acceptanceCriteria: Backend maintains a stable map of admin Principal IDs
Provides isAdmin query method that accepts a Principal and returns boolean
Provides addAdmin and removeAdmin update methods restricted to existing admins
Initial deployment grants admin status to the deployer Principal

requirements.text: Update the JobRoleForm component to include proficiency level selection (beginner, intermediate, advanced) for each skill when adding or editing skills for a job role.

quotes: Skill proficiency levels (beginner, intermediate, advanced) when adding/editing skills

acceptanceCriteria: JobRoleForm displays a dropdown or select input for proficiency level for each skill
Proficiency level options are beginner, intermediate, and advanced
Selected proficiency level is saved with the skill when creating or editing a job role
Existing skills display their current proficiency level when editing

requirements.text: Enforce admin-only access to the AdminPanel page by verifying the user's Principal has admin permissions using the backend admin registry.

quotes: Internet Identity authentication to protect the admin panel
Admin permission levels for access control

acceptanceCriteria: AdminPanel page checks if the authenticated user is an admin via backend query
Non-admin users see the AccessDeniedScreen component when attempting to access admin routes
Admin navigation link in Layout only appears for authenticated admin users
Unauthenticated users are prompted to log in before accessing admin features

requirements.text: Display skill proficiency levels in the AdminPanel job role cards and in the JobRoleSelector component so users can see the required proficiency for each skill.
acceptanceCriteria: AdminPanel displays proficiency level badges next to each skill name
JobRoleSelector shows proficiency levels in the skill preview
Proficiency levels use distinct visual styling (color or badge variant) for beginner, intermediate, and advanced

requirements.text: Update the skill matching and gap analysis logic to consider proficiency levels when comparing resume skills against job role requirements, matching both skill name and proficiency level.
acceptanceCriteria: Skill matching considers both skill name and proficiency level
A skill is marked as matching only if the resume skill meets or exceeds the required proficiency level
Gap analysis shows which skills are missing or below the required proficiency level
Match percentage calculation accounts for proficiency level matching

constraints: Use the existing AdminGuard component pattern for protecting admin routes
Maintain compatibility with existing JobRole and Skill data structures in the backend
Do not modify Internet Identity authentication implementation
Preserve existing resume analysis and matching functionality
nonGoals: Multi-level admin roles (e.g., super admin, moderator)
Admin user management UI for adding/removing other admins
Custom proficiency level definitions beyond beginner/intermediate/advanced
